_note: Gate monotonicity (C-06). Each value is the HIGH-WATER assertion count that gate has ever reported green. `_lib.markGreen()` raises it on every green run and never lowers it; `gate-ratchet` fails any gate that reports fewer assertions than its high-water. The sanctioned way down is an entry in the `adr` map naming which check was removed and why it was wrong — an ADR replaces the value instead of preserving it, and gate-ratchet's second assertion requires the ADR to carry all three of removed/why/week so that an empty object is not a free pass.
